blocks.text: ALBUQUERQUE, New Mexico — A New Mexico judge has dismissed an indictment against “West Wing” and “Field of Dreams” actor Timothy Busfield that accused him of criminal sexual contact with a child, citing prosecutorial misconduct and errors that undermined the grand jury process. State District Judge Joseph Montano granted a defense motion to toss the charges in a decision released Friday, Oct. 16. Busfield has repeatedly denied the allegations, describing them as lies motivated by revenge.
